spells.name: Acid Arrow
spells.description: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target; on a hit it deals acid damage immediately and again at the end of its next turn, or deals reduced damage on a miss.

spells.name: Aid
spells.description: Bolster the hit points of up to three creatures; each gains 5 temporary hit points for 8 hours.

spells.name: Alter Self
spells.description: Assume a different form with natural weapons, aquatic adaptation, or a changed appearance while you concentrate.

spells.name: Arcane Lock
spells.description: Touch a closed door, window, gate, chest, or other entryway to lock it magically until the spell is dispelled or suppressed.

spells.name: Arcanist's Magic Aura
spells.description: Mask the magic of an object so divination spells treat it as nonmagical, or give a nonmagical object a false magical aura, for a long duration.

spells.name: Augury
spells.description: Using special tokens, receive an omen about a planned action within 30 minutes as weal, woe, weal and woe, or nothing.

spells.name: Blindness/Deafness
spells.description: Force a creature to make a Constitution save or become blinded or deafened (your choice) for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

spells.name: Blur
spells.description: Your body becomes blurred, imposing disadvantage on attack rolls against you while you concentrate, unless the attacker does not rely on sight.

spells.name: Calm Emotions
spells.description: Attempt to suppress strong emotions in a group; creatures that fail a Charisma save become indifferent or have charm/fear effects suppressed while you concentrate.

spells.name: Continual Flame
spells.description: Create a flame that sheds light like a torch but produces no heat and consumes no oxygen; it lasts until dispelled.

spells.name: Darkness
spells.description: Fill a 15-foot-radius sphere with magical darkness that blocks even darkvision, unless a creature can see through magical darkness.

spells.name: Darkvision
spells.description: Touch a willing creature to grant it darkvision out to 60 feet for 8 hours.

spells.name: Detect Thoughts
spells.description: Read surface thoughts of creatures you focus on, and probe deeper if they fail a Wisdom save, while you concentrate.

spells.name: Enhance Ability
spells.description: Touch a creature to grant advantage on checks with one chosen ability, and related benefits such as temporary hit points or doubled carrying capacity, while you concentrate.

spells.name: Enlarge/Reduce
spells.description: Cause a creature or object to grow or shrink for the duration; an unwilling creature can negate the effect with a Constitution save.

spells.name: Find Traps
spells.description: Sense the presence of any trap within line of sight out to a limited range; you learn the danger exists but not its exact location or nature.

spells.name: Flaming Sphere
spells.description: Create a 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire you can move as a bonus action; creatures ending their turn near it, or hit by it, take fire damage on a failed Dexterity save.

spells.name: Gentle Repose
spells.description: Touch a corpse or other remains so they don't decay and can't become undead for 10 days.

spells.name: Gust of Wind
spells.description: A line of strong wind blasts from you; creatures that fail a Strength save are pushed, and the wind disperses gases and extinguishes unprotected flames.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.description: A humanoid you can see must succeed on a Wisdom save or be paralyzed for the duration; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.description: A creature you touch becomes invisible until it attacks or casts a spell, or until the duration ends.

spells.name: Knock
spells.description: Make a loud knock that unlocks or unbars a locked object, suppresses arcane lock for a time, or opens a stuck door or similar.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.description: Touch a creature and end one disease or one condition among blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.description: One willing creature or object rises vertically and remains suspended while you concentrate; you can change its altitude as part of your move.

spells.name: Locate Object
spells.description: Sense the direction to a familiar object within 1,000 feet, or the nearest object of a described general type, while you concentrate.

spells.name: Magic Mouth
spells.description: Implant a message in an object that is spoken aloud when a trigger condition you define occurs.

spells.name: Magic Weapon
spells.description: Touch a nonmagical weapon to make it a magic weapon with a bonus to attack and damage rolls while you concentrate.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.description: Three illusory duplicates of you appear; attacks that would hit you may strike an image instead until the images are destroyed or the spell ends.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.description: As a bonus action, briefly surround yourself with silvery mist and teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

spells.name: Prayer of Healing
spells.description: Over 10 minutes, restore hit points to up to six creatures of your choice within range.

spells.name: Protection from Poison
spells.description: Touch a creature to neutralize poison and grant advantage on saves against being poisoned, plus resistance to poison damage, for 1 hour.

spells.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
spells.description: A black ray forces a creature hit by a ranged spell attack to deal only half damage with Strength-based weapon attacks until it succeeds on a Constitution save.

spells.name: Rope Trick
spells.description: A rope rises into an extradimensional space that holds up to eight creatures for the duration; the rope can be pulled up to hide the entrance.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.description: Hurl three rays of fire; make a ranged spell attack for each ray, dealing fire damage on a hit.

spells.name: See Invisibility
spells.description: For the duration you see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible, and can see into the Ethereal Plane.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.description: A sudden loud ringing noise deals thunder damage in a sphere; creatures take a Constitution save for half, and nonmagical objects that aren't worn or carried also take the damage.

spells.name: Silence
spells.description: Create a 20-foot-radius sphere of silence for the duration; no sound can be created inside or pass through, blocking verbal components.

spells.name: Spider Climb
spells.description: Touch a willing creature so it can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and ceilings while leaving its hands free.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.description: Create a floating spectral weapon that strikes a creature for force damage and can be moved and attacked with again as a bonus action on later turns.

spells.name: Suggestion
spells.description: Suggest a course of activity limited to a sentence or two; a creature that fails a Wisdom save pursues the suggestion in a way that isn't obviously harmful.

spells.name: Warding Bond
spells.description: Touch a willing creature; while within 60 feet you both share a protective bond that improves its defenses and splits damage it takes with you.

spells.name: Web
spells.description: Fill an area with thick, sticky webbing that is difficult terrain and can restrain creatures that fail a Dexterity save while you concentrate.

spells.name: Zone of Truth
spells.description: Creatures in an area that fail a Charisma save cannot deliberately lie for the duration, though they may avoid answering.
